Recap:

Clarifying Qs (so the quote is accurate):

2) Do you need reserved throughput (steady SLO) or is bursting acceptable for initial months?
3) Contract length you prefer (12 vs 24 months) and whether you want committed reserved capacity.

Ballpark (preliminary, non-binding) — assuming 12-month term and mixed workload across routes:
- Baseline tier (0–15M/mo): $380 per 1M tokens
- Growth tier (15M–50M/mo): $300 per 1M tokens
- Scale tier (50M+): $240 per 1M tokens
Blended example: if you move from 10M to 50M over the term, the blended rate lands ~ $280–$300 per 1M depending on step-up timing.

Add-ons / notes:
- Reranking route (low latency, higher compute): +20–40% on top of base token rate unless we include reserved capacity for those requests.
- Embeddings route: typically cheaper per token but billed per embedding unit — we'll convert to token-equivalent for a blended quote.
- Quantization/optimized model variants: we can reduce unit cost by ~15–25% but need to validate quality on your prompts.
- One-time items: onboarding/solutions engineering spike (est. 8–12 hours) and a standard enterprise MSA review (legal).

Next steps I propose:
- You send the best-available split (generation/embeddings/reranking) and a sample monthly distribution (use the attached usage-breakdown-template.csv).
- We produce a formal quote with blended tiers + a draft DocuSign-ready proposal and MSA.
- Optional: 30-day canary (hosted) to validate performance and blended assumptions before a reserved commit.

I've attached a short pricing blend PDF (redwood-pricing-blend-v2.pdf) and a usage template. Marissa will own the formal quote and pricing sequencing.
